thread:
sam: Quick sync: CloudPartner X asked for a condensed "terra-kit" they can ship in their marketplace catalog. They want 1) opinionated terraform modules, 2) a CI smoke harness, and 3) packaging instructions.

june: Got it. Do we need to include billing alerts or cost-estimates per deployment? They mentioned cost concerns for GPU SKU choices.

omar: Recommend we include a cost-estimates.md that lists recommended instance families + monthly cost ballparks and an example of how to enable spot vs reserved. Keep it optional param.

viv: We should also add a tiny sample app that starts a container running a tiny toy LLM and exposes /health and /infer. That makes the marketplace listing more credible.

sam: Agree. Minimal repo layout idea:
```
/modules/network/
/modules/compute/
/modules/deploy/
/examples/one-click/
/tests/e2e/
/ci/gh-actions.yml
/packaging/manifest.yaml
```

june: For CI, prefer GHA but include a matrix for self-hosted runner label. Tests: terraform fmt/validate, terratest e2e, and an optional perf probe (curl loop) to record p50/p95.

omar: Security hooks: support KMS key_id and audit_log_sink variables. Add a snippet showing how to wire in customer KMS.

viv: Packaging: CloudPartner X requires a manifest with checksum and a small install script. I'll draft packaging/pack.sh that zips modules and produces sha256sum.

pm-bot: Reminder: partner kickoff call tomorrow 11:00 PST (invite sent to sara@cloudpartnerx.com).

sam: Owners: sam (PM), omar (infra lead - modules), viv (eng - examples + packaging), june (devex - docs + CI). I'll open a GH repo and add ISSUE_TEMPLATE with checklist.

june: Also add a short troubleshooting section for common terraform failures (provider auth, quota errors, region mismatches). Small snippets help.

omar: Example compute snippet for README: 
```hcl
module "redwood_llm_pool" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/terra-kit/modules/compute"
  cloud = "aws"
  region = "us-west-2"
  instance_type = "g5.xlarge"
  gpu_count = 1
  enable_autoscaler = true
}
```

viv: Will also add experiment instructions for quantized model setups and a note about recommended docker base images.

sam: Timeline: repo skeleton + LICENSE by EOD Friday, basic CI + smoke test next Wed, partner tech review the following week. Any blockers?

june: Legal will need the co-marketing copy for the marketplace tile and the partner logo pack. Carla on partner side handles that, pinged them.

omar: I'll include a smoke test at tests/e2e/smoke_test.go that deploys the example and checks /health then runs 10 requests against /infer.

viv: I'll add a small bench script `bench.sh` in examples that reports p50/p95 using hey or k6. Optional for customers.

pm-bot: Action created: CPX-TK-47 (create terra-kit repo skeleton) assigned to sam.

sam: Cool, I'll drop the repo link when ready. Also adding a short README snippet about supported regions and cost tradeoffs.

june: Thanks all :rocket:

sam: End of thread — posting notes into the project board and onto the partner channel.
